```yaml
name: Backend Required Checks

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  setup-python:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: getsentry/action-setup-venv@5a80476d175edf56cb205b08bc58986fa99d1725
        with:
          python-version: '3.8'
          cache-dependency-path: requirements.txt
          venv-dir: .venv

      - name: Activate virtual environment
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate

  test-backend:
    needs: setup-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

  security-check:
    needs: setup-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run security scan
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  coverage-report:
    needs: setup-python
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    steps:
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run coverage report
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: '**/*.py'
          directory: .
          fail-ci-if-error: true

  track-performance:
    needs: [test-backend, security-check, coverage-report]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Track workflow performance
        uses: PostHog/posthog-github-action@eea1405eeb2d1d2259f0ee0b44d7b152869e6840
        with:
          posthog-token: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_TOKEN }}
          event: 'Backend Required Checks Completed'
          properties: '{"status": "success"}'
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file sets up a pipeline for running backend-related checks such as tests, security scans, and coverage reports. It includes conditional execution based on the type of event (push or pull request) and ensures that the required checks are only run when relevant files are modified. The workflow also tracks the performance of the checks using PostHog.
